items.colloc: accrual basis 應計基礎 | interest accrual 利息累計
items.distinct: cash basis 現金基礎 | provision 準備金
ex: The accounting department uses the accrual method.
會計部門使用應計會計法。
Interest accrual is calculated on a monthly basis.
利息累計是按月計算的。
We must record every accrual in the ledger.
我們必須在帳簿中記錄每一筆應計項目。

items.colloc: amortization schedule 攤提表 | annual amortization 年度攤提
items.distinct: depreciation 折舊 | write-off 撇帳
ex: Review the amortization schedule for the loan.
請檢查該貸款的分期償還表。
Annual amortization reduces the asset's book value.
年度攤提降低了資產的帳面價值。
They finalized the amortization of the intangible asset.
他們完成了無形資產的攤提計算。

items.colloc: financial solvency 財務償債能力 | maintain solvency 維持償債能力
items.distinct: liquidity 流動性 | profitability 獲利能力
ex: The firm’s long-term solvency remains quite stable.
該公司的長期償債能力依然相當穩定。
Investors are concerned about our current solvency.
投資人擔憂我們目前的償債能力。
We must maintain solvency during this crisis.
我們必須在危機期間維持償債能力。

items.colloc: consolidated statement 合併報表 | consolidated report 綜合報告
items.distinct: combined 聯合的 | integrated 整合的
ex: The parent company issued a consolidated statement.
母公司發布了一份合併報表。
Review the consolidated report before the meeting.
開會前請審閱那份綜合報告。
The figures represent our consolidated financial results.
這些數字代表了我們的合併財務結果。

items.colloc: impact the bottom-line 影響淨利 | improve the bottom-line 改善淨利
items.distinct: gross profit 毛利 | net income 淨收入
ex: Rising costs will negatively impact our bottom-line.
成本上升將對我們的淨利造成負面影響。
We need strategies to improve the bottom-line.
我們需要能改善淨利的策略。
Efficiency is essential for the company's bottom-line.
效率對公司的淨利至關重要。

items.pos: n. 資產減值；帳面減值
items.colloc: significant write-down 重大減值 | inventory write-down 存貨跌價損失
items.distinct: write-off 撇帳 | devaluation 貶值
ex: The board approved a major inventory write-down.
董事會批准了一項重大的存貨跌價損失。
A write-down reflects the lower market value.
資產減值反映了較低的市場價值。
Recent losses forced a write-down of assets.
近期的虧損迫使資產進行減值處理。

items.pos: adj. 槓桿的；負債經營的
items.colloc: highly leveraged 高度槓桿 | leveraged buyout 槓桿收購
items.distinct: indebted 負債的 | financed 融資的
ex: The company is too highly leveraged right now.
該公司目前槓桿操作程度過高。
They announced a risky leveraged buyout plan.
他們宣佈了一項高風險的槓桿收購計畫。
Being heavily leveraged increases our financial risk.
過度槓桿化增加了我們的財務風險。

items.pos: n. 經常性支出；營運成本
items.colloc: reduce overhead 降低營運成本 | fixed overhead 固定成本
items.distinct: operating cost 營運成本 | direct cost 直接成本
ex: We must find ways to reduce our overhead.
我們必須想辦法降低經常性支出。
High overhead is eating into our profit margin.
高額的營運成本正在侵蝕我們的利潤率。
The report breaks down all fixed overhead.
該報告列出了所有固定成本明細。

items.colloc: accounts receivable 應收帳款 | manage receivables 管理應收帳款
items.distinct: payables 應付帳款 | assets 資產
ex: Our accounts receivable are higher than expected.
我們的應收帳款高於預期。
Please track the outstanding trade receivables.
請追蹤所有未結清的貿易應收帳款。
Effective management of receivables improves cash flow.
有效管理應收帳款能改善現金流。

items.colloc: market volatility 市場波動 | reduce volatility 降低波動
items.distinct: instability 不穩定 | fluctuation 起伏
ex: We should prepare for increased market volatility.
我們應為加劇的市場波動做好準備。
The stock price shows significant volatility lately.
股價近期顯示出顯著的波動性。
High volatility makes long-term planning difficult.
高波動性讓長期規劃變得困難。

items.colloc: accrued interest 應計利息 | accrued expenses 應計費用
items.distinct: accumulated 累積的 | deferred 遞延的
ex: Check the report for all accrued interest.
檢查報告中所有的應計利息。
The accrued expenses must be paid soon.
那些應計費用必須儘快支付。
We calculated the total accrued liability today.
我們今天計算了總應計負債。

items.colloc: capital outlay 資本支出 | initial outlay 初期投入
items.distinct: expenditure 開支 | expense 費用
ex: The project requires a large capital outlay.
該專案需要龐大的資本支出。
We need to justify this initial outlay.
我們必須說明這筆初期投入的合理性。
Total outlay exceeded our original budget plan.
總支出超過了我們原本的預算計畫。
